name: honeybill
description: Single-tenant billing software with ZUGFeRD/XRechnung e-invoice support

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @honeybill/shared build && pnpm --filter @honeybill/api build && pnpm --filter @honeybill/web build
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @honeybill/api migrate && pnpm --filter @honeybill/api seed
